title: Refine UI Text: Master CSS 'font-kerning' for Precise Letter Spacing and Visual Balance
tweet: Boost your UI's visual polish! Discover how CSS 'font-kerning' fine-tunes letter spacing for impeccable web typography. Elevate user experience with this subtle yet powerful CSS typography trick. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: Many modern web fonts include kerning information for optimal letter pair spacing. However, browser defaults or specific font settings might sometimes ignore it. Using 'font-kerning: normal;' explicitly ensures that the browser applies the font's built-in kerning, improving readability and visual balance, especially for headings and display text. Use 'none' for performance-critical areas with less precise font requirements, or 'auto' for browser-determined behavior.
